purpose: Make disposable parallel chats behave like coordinated Prometeo workers with minimal repeated reasoning.
authority_rule: Runtime coordinates work only. Current, Catalog, Lineage, Human Accepted and Served keep their existing owners.

Prometeo: Resync before answering the unfinished human intent.
Load the stable entry and current runtime manifest.
Infer the current workstream/surface from the conversation; do not ask the human to repeat context when it can be recovered.
Prefer one compiled active Work Packet. If no active workstream matches, use the catalog surface route plus the compiled GENERAL packet rather than guessing or crawling the whole repository.
Recover branch drift from packet activity deltas rather than restarting repository archaeology.
Choose the execution profile and continue the last materially unsatisfied request.
End with a Prometeo Seal only if the runtime and a compiled packet were actually loaded.
If a Prometeo workstream is already active, continue its current execution frontier without regenerating context/maps/specification.
If no runtime packet is active, resync Prometeo first and continue the previously agreed next action.

routing_order: otherwise match a generated Catalog surface card
load GENERAL compiled packet for unregistered surface work
create a small scoped PACK only when material writes actually begin
compiled_context_rule: Agents should consume compiled Work Packets before raw PACK/NOW/DELTA files. Raw owners remain available for drift, ambiguity or authority questions.

conditional: Current/Catalog/Lineage when authority affects the decision
Release contracts only when crossing release boundaries
historical sources only when a contradiction cannot be resolved from recent state

surface_fallback.rule: A catalog surface without an active workstream is routable, but GENERAL does not grant write ownership. Create a scoped workstream before material writes.

seal.rule: Never print 🟣 P✓ unless the current stable entry and one compiled packet were successfully loaded during this work cycle.

efficiency_law: Maximize durable useful delta per turn: useful product change + future work eliminated + reusable learning + human friction removed - repeated reasoning - coordination overhead - verification loops.
return_rule: RETURN is an accelerator, not authority. If missing or stale, reconstruct only the small Git delta since the last known head.
